message: v1.8.6: Fix quiz date and HTML announcement extraction edge cases
changelog: Windows Widget Automatic Self-Update (windows-widget/SelfUpdater.cs, windows-widget/TrayApplicationContext.cs, windows-widget/SettingsForm.cs): Added automatic GitHub Releases self-updating for BlackboarderWidget.exe (yvs1n/blackboarder-extension/releases/latest), checking on startup and every 3 hours when idle, validating the downloaded PE executable size and MZ header, swapping the in-use binary safely on NTFS, relaunching automatically, and providing an Auto-Update toggle plus Check for Updates action in both Settings and the system tray menu. Synchronized <Version> in BlackboarderWidget.csproj with package.json during npm run build.
